concerns.text: FR-004 (threshold ≥ 0.75 enforcement) has no implemented task. T012 (CLI argument validator) is listed as missing, and no other task ensures the threshold cannot be set below 0.75.
FR-010 (structured JSON‑Line logging) is not covered because the central logger module T006 is missing.
FR-012 (global `--seed` handling for reproducibility) lacks a dedicated task; while T024 adds an `evaluate` sub‑command, no task records or propagates the seed throughout the pipeline.
FR-018 requires the `baseline_p` field in `evaluation_metrics.json`, but no task explicitly generates or validates this field.
FR-034 mandates a versioned logging schema (`pipeline_log.schema.yaml`). No task creates or validates this schema file.
FR-035 (recording command‑line invocation, software versions, and random seed in `pipeline.log`) is not implemented; T098 (logger extension) is listed as missing.
SC-001 (AUROC ≥ 0.70 and AUPRC ≥ 0.65) has no CI test or verification task asserting that the computed metrics meet these thresholds (e.g., a test that fails if metrics fall below the targets).
SC-003 (pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) is not verified; the benchmark runtime check T063 references a non‑existent task T046, leaving the runtime constraint untested.
SC-004 (reproducibility across runs with the same seed) lacks a concrete verification task that re‑runs the pipeline and asserts identical outputs.
Although T064 implements a GEO downloader, there is no task that creates the configuration file `species.yaml` (required by FR‑001 for per‑species accession lists).
FR-009 (Makefile orchestration and ≤ 6 h runtime) is partially covered by T008, but there is no task that validates the Makefile’s target dependencies or enforces the overall runtime budget.
FR-013 (validation of `predicted_ppi_*.tsv` against its contract) is referenced by T011, yet no task creates the `predicted_ppi.schema.yaml` contract file.
FR-019 (validation of `evaluation_metrics.json` against its contract) is referenced by T115, but the contract file `evaluation.schema.yaml` is not created by any task.
FR-030 (validation of `threshold_sensitivity_*.tsv` against its contract) is referenced by T086, yet no task creates `threshold_sensitivity.schema.yaml`.

FR-045 (Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR ≤ 0.05 for edge inclusion) is implemented by T083, but there is no task that verifies that the FDR‑adjusted p‑value filter is applied before edge selection (e.g., a unit test confirming only edges with adjusted p ≤ 0.05 are written).

FR-014 (batch‑effect correction and confound regression) is partially covered by T065/T065a, but there is no task that validates the presence of the corrected expression matrix or checks that confound regression was performed.
FR-016 (balanced negative sampling) is covered by T091, yet no task asserts that the negative set is truly the complement of the STRING high‑confidence set.
FR-017 (post‑target verification script) is referenced by T011 and T056, but there is no dedicated task that runs this verification after every Make target.

FR-021 (per‑species summary report) is covered by T126/T127, but no task checks that the summary includes all required fields (edge count, evaluation metrics, top GO terms, sensitivity analysis, construct‑validity justification).
FR-022 (report top enriched GO terms) is implied by T126, yet no explicit test verifies that the top terms are correctly extracted and ordered.
FR-023 (threshold‑sensitivity analysis) is covered by T085/T086, but there is no task that validates the output schema and ensures the analysis respects the global seed.

FR-024 (graceful handling of no significant enrichment) is covered by T044, but no test confirms that the pipeline proceeds without error when the file contains only the ‘No significant enrichment’ line.
FR-028 (final aggregated report) is covered by T127, yet there is no task that validates that the final report aggregates per‑species summaries correctly.
FR-032 (negative‑sampling strategy) is covered by T091, but no task verifies that the sampling uses the global seed and that the negative set size equals the positive set.
FR-034 (logging schema versioning) is not linked to any task that creates or validates `pipeline_log.schema.yaml`.
FR-035 (recording exact command‑line invocation, software versions, and seed) is missing; T098 is listed as absent.
Phase 0 tasks T001, T003, T004, and T005 are missing, violating repository setup, R environment, linting configuration, and CI workflow requirements.

Phase 1 tasks T006, T009, T010, T012, T013, T098, T099, and T100 are missing, leaving central logging, configuration files, schema contracts, threshold validator, citation verification, logger extension, and related CI tests unimplemented.
Task T046 referenced by T063 (benchmark runtime verification) does not exist, causing a broken dependency.
Task T108 claims to be a duplicate of T064, but the ID is unique; the comment creates confusion about ID conflict without an actual duplicate ID.
While evaluation tasks exist (T022, T023, T091, T092), there is no task that explicitly computes AUROC/AUPRC on the *full* imbalanced set before any thresholding, as required by FR‑006.
Baseline generation (T023) exists, but no task validates that the baseline preserves node degree distribution or that the permutation‑test p‑value is computed.
Raw correlation storage is implemented by T016a, yet no task verifies that the gzipped TSV is complete and parsable for all species.
FR‑025 duplicates FR‑020; ensure a task explicitly checks that raw correlation files are retained before any thresholding.
The contract `threshold_sensitivity.schema.yaml` is referenced but no task creates it.
BH correction is performed (T083), but there is no task that asserts edges are filtered by adjusted p‑value ≤ 0.05 before writing the final edge list.
